hypothesis: Fixed trend and stop thresholds fail differently across input technology pools. Learn a shared mapping from normalized, causal price/volume/breadth conditions to subsequently realized return and adverse excursion, using only labels fully matured before each historical decision. No future-trained model may be backfilled into earlier decisions.
features: Current and trailing 5/20/60/120-session log momentum with since-observed fallback; EMA20/EMA60 separation; realized downside RMS20; volatility5/volatility20; log volume/prior20mean; close location within today's range; loss from trailing20high; supplied-pool breadth above EMA20; interaction of long momentum and latest negative return; squared20momentum. No symbols, sectors, calendar dates, reference strategy labels, absent securities or post-2023-external data enter the predictor.

learning.targets: log(close[t+horizon]/open[t+1]) and max(0,1-min(close[t+1:t+horizon+1])/open[t+1]); discard incomplete/missing label paths
learning.maturity: At signal close i a fit can use t only when t+horizon<=i. Standardization and exponentially weighted ridge coefficients use only these admissible rows. Equal total weight per label date prevents a larger active universe from dominating a date. Store each fit cutoff and sample count.
learning.ridge: Weighted squared error plus shrinkage times squared standardized coefficients; intercept unpenalized. The same fit is shared across supplied names and is rebuilt after any universe removal.
learning.warmup: Before twenty label dates mature, use positive multi-horizon momentum with at least ten observed prices as an explicit nonlearned prior; do not hold the account empty for sixty sessions.

ownership.score: predicted horizon log return minus predicted adverse excursion; clip prediction only to finite economic bounds, not acceptance thresholds
ownership.admission: positive score, current close above EMA10 and positive five-session return; top positions names, persistent units; only review membership every twenty sessions or fill vacancies
ownership.exit: two consecutive negative expected-utility closes OR observed owned-price peak loss >=12% OR stale quote. Protective intent remains latched until actual liquidation; exit proceeds cannot fund new entries on that signal close.
ownership.concentration: Entry cap60%, drift cap80%, both100% for a single-name input. Review replacement only when held rank exceeds twice capacity and challenger score materially exceeds incumbent; no routine equal-weight rebalance.
ownership.risk_pause: Five-session new-money pause after a newly triggered protective exit, with failed orders retried.
ownership.execution: Unchanged production cash-only close decision/next-open execution, fees, prior-only capacity, lot-equivalent constraints and ordinary whole-account1% materiality. No intraday fills or leverage.

selection_rule: Prefer every-scope incumbent nonregression in wealth, maximum drawdown and fills; otherwise minimize the worst normalized deficit and label diagnostic. Within equal deficits use the original mean log-relative-wealth minus drawdown/turnover objective. This is a necessary screen, not replacement of the original four-reference, crash and subset goals.
validation: Causal prefix equality for forecasts, fit cutoffs, orders and NAV; fit labels cannot reach beyond signal date; changing excluded securities cannot alter a supplied subset; no new dependencies beyond NumPy/pandas; retain every candidate and failed predecessor. Already-observed2026 remains retrospective.
